checks.title: Mon 16 Nov · morning check

EURUSD.hook: The dollar opened the week at a 19-month high, and Paris sent nothing new to answer it.

GBPUSD.hook: Sterling waits for Tuesday while the greenback starts Monday on the front foot.

USDJPY.hook: Japan's economy stalled in the third quarter, and the yen lost a little more footing.

USDCHF.hook: The franc had nothing to lean on overnight, and the dollar index sat at a 19-month high.

USDCAD.hook: Oil slipped again at the open, giving the loonie one more worry before its CPI.

AUDUSD.hook: China's October numbers missed across the board, but the stand-off holds.

NZDUSD.hook: Weak Chinese demand is a small cloud over the kiwi's dairy story.

EURGBP.hook: A quiet Asian night for two European currencies whose stories start later today.

EURJPY.hook: The yen's side of this lean got weaker overnight.

EURCHF.hook: Still dead level, with the franc's data due this morning.

EURAUD.hook: China's soft data took a little shine off the Aussie, but not enough to matter.

EURNZD.hook: Both sides start the week waiting: the euro on Paris, the kiwi on dairy.

EURCAD.hook: Cheaper oil nudged this stand-off slightly toward the euro, on paper only.

GBPJPY.hook: The yen stumbled on GDP, but the pound has not shown up yet.

GBPCHF.hook: No fear in Asia, no help for the franc.

GBPAUD.hook: China's slowdown gives the pound a sliver of hope in this tie.

GBPNZD.hook: Level at +1 each, and Asia's data did not split them.

GBPCAD.hook: Oil gave the pound a small helping hand before Canada's inflation test.

AUDJPY.hook: Two Asian data misses, and they pulled in opposite directions.

AUDCHF.hook: The carry gap survived China's soft numbers.

AUDNZD.hook: China's slowdown hits both neighbours, so it does not separate them.

AUDCAD.hook: Oil dipped, China missed, and the lean barely noticed.

NZDJPY.hook: The yen blinked first, but the stand-off stays.

NZDCHF.hook: A calm Asian session keeps the kiwi's lean over the franc.

NZDCAD.hook: Oil gave way a little more, and the dairy side is still waiting for its auction.

CADJPY.hook: Both legs got weaker overnight, so this lean is under watch.

CADCHF.hook: Two weak currencies, and cheaper oil did the loonie no favours.

CHFJPY.hook: The yen's small edge over the franc wobbled on Japan's GDP.

XAUUSD.hook: Gold got no new fuel overnight, and the dollar stayed firm.

USD.note: Dec 25bp hike priced 92–94%, 50bp tail down to 6–8% (from 11.5% Fri); no Fed policy shift overnight; Warsh 19:00 Bucharest.

EUR.note: No French spread or budget item overnight; Senate resumes the PLFSS spending debate today.

GBP.note: No BoE item overnight; UK jobs Tue 09:00 and CPI Wed 09:00 Bucharest.

JPY.note: Q3 GDP −0.1% ann. vs +0.3% exp.: shadow R3 −1, raw −0.9 held at 0; BoJ Dec pricing fade not seen; no MoF comment.

CHF.note: No SNB item; Swiss Q3 GDP flash 10:00 Bucharest (after this check).

CAD.note: Brent −1% to $94.86 early Monday on IEA surplus view (N1 info only); Canada CPI 15:30, poll 3.2%.

AUD.note: China Oct data missed (IP 4.8%, retail 0.4%, FAI −8.1% YTD): MEDIUM, no factor; RBA minutes Tue 02:30.

NZD.note: China's soft retail sales are a dairy-demand risk; no RBNZ or vote update; GDT Tue 14:00.

XAU.note: Gold factor −3 unchanged; no ETF/central-bank data; 10y 5.14%; Bab el-Mandeb did not trigger risk-off.
